Hija de Teodoro I de Monferrato, se casó: Daughter of Theodore I of Montferrat, married Aimon of Savoy. Her descent linked with the emperor Andronikos II and the allergenic heiress Yolanda, named Irene in Byzantium.
Hija de Teodoro II de Morea y esposa de: The daughter of Theodore II of Morea and wife of John II, favored the Greek institutions of Cyprus. She was Carlota's mother. Her presence in the court allows him to follow the links between the Lusignan Mediterranean and the last Byzantine world.
Hija de Tomás I de Saboya, se casó con R: Daughter of Thomas I of Savoy, married Ramón Berenguer IV of Provence. Her daughters linked with the French and English monarchies and the houses of Anjou and Cornwall.
Hija de Vajtang VI y esposa de Teimuraz: Daughter of Vakhtang VI and wife of Teimuraz II, she linked the branches of Kartli and Kakheti. She was the mother of Heraclio II, who would gather both crowns in 1762.

Hija del gran duque Francisco I de Tosca: Daughter of the grand duke Francis I of Tuscany and second wife of Henry IV of France. Regent for his son Louis XIII after the murder of the king in 1610, she ended up banished after facing Richelieu.
Hija del infante Juan y nieta de Juan I,: Daughter of John's infant and granddaughter of John I, she married his cousin Ferdinand, Duke of Viseu. Widowed since 1470, she ruled the Duchy of Beja and was the mother of Manuel I and Queen Leonor; she died in Beja in 1506.
Hija del rey Duarte de Portugal y de Leo: The daughter of King Duarte of Portugal and Leonor of Aragon, married Frederick III and was crowned Empress in Rome in 1452. Mother of Maximilian I, died in 1467.
Hija del rey Jano de Chipre, se casó con: The daughter of King Jano of Cyprus, married Louis of Savoy and brought a direct connection to the Lusignan to the Alpine court. Her numerous descendants linked with France, Milan and the Cypriot succession itself.

Hijo de Adolfo I y María de Borgoña, suc: The son of Adolf I and Mary of Burgundy, he succeeded in Cléveris in 1448. Mark's trajectory was different; the county should not be confused with the entire Sauerland region.
Hijo de Adolfo, recuperó el gobierno de: The son of Adolfo, regained the government of Guelders in 1492 and resisted the habsburgic expansion for decades. His trajectory shows that the borgognone acquisition of 1473 did not definitely close the ducal history.
Hijo de Alain de Albret y Françoise de C: The son of Alain of Albret and Françoise of Châtillon, married Catherine of Navarre. Hijo de Alberto II de Mecklemburgo y Euf: The son of Albert II of Mecklenburg and Euphemy of Sweden, and the brother of King Albert of Sweden. He married Ingeborg, daughter of Valdemar IV. Hijo de Alejandro I y hermano de Vajtang: The son of Alexander I and brother of Vakhtang IV, he participated in the distribution of power among the royal princes. Hijo de Alejandro Lăpușneanu y Ruxandra: The son of Alexander Lăpușneanu and Ruxandra Rareș, he joined the government during his minority. His mother exercised regency until 1570.

Hijo de Alfonso Fadrique, sucedió a su h: The son of Alfonso Fadrique, succeeded his brother Peter as Count of Salona in 1355. His son Louis followed him in 1365.
Hijo de Alfonso II de Aragón, gobernó Pr: The son of Alfonso II of Aragon, he ruled Provence in the name of his father since 1185 and remained count until his death in 1196. Hijo de Andrónico II y de Irene de Monfe: The son of Andronikos II and Irene de Montferrat, he moved from the Byzantine imperial family to the government of an Italian marquisate. His rights came from his mother, but he had to defend them against competitors.

The son of Andronikos II and Irene de Montferrat, he moved from the Byzantine imperial family to the government of an Italian marquisate. Hijo de Andrónico II, asociado al trono: Son of Andrónico II, associated with the throne as co-emperor. He led campaigns against the Turks and the Catalan Company without success, and died before his father in 1320.
Hijo de Arnaud-Amanieu de Albret y Marga: The son of Arnaud- Amanieu of Albret and Margaret of Bourbon, was lord of Albret and constable of France. He died in the battle of Agincourt in 1415. Hijo de Arturo II y de María de Limoges,: The son of Arthur II and Mary of Limoges, he was the brother of John III of Brittany and the father of Joan of Penthièvre. He died before the Duke.
Hijo de Arturo II y de Yolanda de Dreux,: The son of Arturo II and Yolanda of Dreux, he fought the duchy to Joan of Penthièvre after the death of John III. His cause was supported by English and continued after his death, sustained by his wife and his son's supporters.
Hijo de Bagrat V, regresó al trono con a: Son of Bagrat V, returned to the throne with Ottoman support and faced the factions that favoured Archil. His two reigns ended in new expulsions; his death did not end the rivalry between the two lines.
Hijo de Bagrat VI, defendió el trono occ: Son of Bagrat VI, he defended the western throne against Constantine II. His consolidation in Imereti helped to make the division of Georgia permanent. The crown passed to his son Bagrat III.
Hijo de Bagrat VII, heredó un poder estr: Son of Bagrat VII, he inherited a power closely dependent on Persia. The Georgian rebellion of 1625 dislocated its authority and favored Teimuraz I. His death closed another safe attempt to stabilize Kartli through this dynastic branch.
Hijo de Balduino II, último emperador la: Son of Balduin II, last Latin emperor of Constantinople. After the Byzantine reconquest of 1261 he inherited only the title and married Beatriz, daughter of Charles of Anjou.
Hijo de Birger Jarl, elegido rey de Suec: Son of Birger Jarl, elected king of Sweden in 1250 under the regency of his father. His brother Magnus deposed him in 1275.
Hijo de Bohemundo IV y esposo de Isabel: Son of Bohemond IV and husband of Elizabeth of Cyprus. His son Hugh III inherited the Cypriot crown by the mother line, retained the name Lusignan and brought to his descendants the genealogy of the princes of Antioch.
Hijo de Bonifacio III y hermano de Guill: Son of Boniface III and brother of William IX, succeeded his nephew Boniface IV. He was the last Marquis of the legitimate male line of Palaiologoi.

Último rey de Francia del Antiguo Régime: Last King of France of the Old Regime. The financial crisis and the call for the General States led to the French Revolution, which ended with the monarchy and its implementation.
Último rey de Jerusalén que gobernó desd: Last king of Jerusalem who ruled from Acre. After the fall of the city in 1291 he retained the title of Jerusalem while continuing as king of Cyprus.
Último rey de Kartli-Kajetia, heredó una: The last king of Kartli-Kakheti inherited a monarchy weakened by the Persian invasion and family disputes. He applied for Russian protection, but his death preceded the annexation of the kingdom. The dynastic succession did not become another effective reign.
Último rey de Thomond antes del acuerdo: Last king of Thomond before the surrender and restitution agreement with Henry VIII. He handed over his Gaelic rights and received titles from the Crown. Their previous royalty and county are distinguished, whose succession did not follow exactly the same rules.
Último rey efectivo de la Armenia cilici: Last effective king of Armenia cilicia, lost Sis to the Mamluks in 1375 and spent years captive. Liberated, he went through European courts looking for support. His stay in Castile and his death in Paris connect the end of the kingdom with Western Europe.
Única hija superviviente de Thomas, X co: The only surviving daughter of Thomas, X Count of Ormond, received a significant part of the family property. His marriage to Richard Preston and his daughter Elizabeth's inheritance altered the balance between title and inheritance within the Butler.
Ej erció la soberanía de los Países Bajo: She exercised sovereignty over the Low Countries together with Albert and later continued as governor. Her political role was far broader than that of a dynastic consort.
